title: Irreversible bimolecular reaction, A + B gives C
notes: A chemistry that is not in the registry in prt_core/reactions.py, defined as a table entry rather than as code. A is held at 1 on the inlet face and B at 1 on the outlet face, both by Dirichlet condition, and they meet in the pore space. The rate is second order, R = k[A][B], with no biomass and no saturation, so there are two dimensionless groups. The ranges are what the campaign this came from actually spans, and they are what turns a request outside them into a reported extrapolation rather than a quiet answer.
